items.title: feat(ui): SARIF export of a run, reusing the CLI's SARIF generator
items.why: #174 is half done: CSV, JSON, YAML and Markdown routes exist in ziran/interfaces/web/routes/export.py, and SARIF exists only in the CLI and the GitHub Action. SARIF from the UI lets a user feed a UI run to code scanning. The issue files PDF as enterprise, and it needs a branding call, so it stays out. WSJF: value 3, closes the OSS part of an open issue; time 1; risk 2; size 2, one route, one button, one test.
items.promise: A user can download a run as SARIF 2.1.0 from the web UI, the open OSS part of #174. ziran/interfaces/web/routes/export.py gains GET /export/run/{run_id}.sarif: 404 when the run is unknown, 409 when it has no result_json, otherwise generate_sarif(CampaignResult.model_validate(run.result_json)) (ziran/application/cicd/sarif.py:52) as an attachment. ui/src/api/export.ts gains downloadRunSarif, and ui/src/pages/RunDetail.tsx offers it next to YAML and Markdown. Files: ziran/interfaces/web/routes/export.py, ui/src/api/export.ts, ui/src/pages/RunDetail.tsx, a route test under tests/unit/ in the spec-052 TestClient pattern. Outside: PDF and branded reports, Burp payloads and scheduled exports (the issue files these as enterprise), SARIF for the filtered findings list.
acceptance: given a completed run whose result_json is a CampaignResult dump, when GET /api/export/run/{id}.sarif is called, then the response is 200 with an attachment Content-Disposition and a body equal to generate_sarif of that result, at SARIF version 2.1.0
given an unknown run id, then the route returns 404; given a run with no result_json, then it returns 409
given RunDetail, when the export menu opens, then a SARIF entry calls the new route, and `npm run build` and `npm run lint` pass
given the PR head, when ruff, mypy ziran/ and the new route test run, then they pass; the full suite comes from CI
